definitions.explanation: Describes pleasantly cool weather or temperature, especially refreshing coolness in summer or after hot weather.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{涼|すず}しいですね。
{秋|あき}は{涼|すず}しくなります。
{涼|すず}しい{風|かぜ}が{気持|きも}ちいい。
{山|やま}の{上|うえ}は{涼|すず}しくて、{夏|なつ}でも{過|す}ごしやすい。
examples.english: It's cool at the top of the mountain, so it's easy to spend time there even in summer.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{開|あ}けたら{涼|すず}しい{空気|くうき}が{入|はい}ってきました。
examples.english: When I opened the window, cool air came in.

notes:
{涼|すず}しい is an i-adjective meaning pleasantly cool or refreshing - the comfortable coolness that brings relief from heat.

FORMS:
- Negative: {涼|すず}しくない
- Past: {涼|すず}しかった
- Adverb: {涼|すず}しく

TEMPERATURE ADJECTIVES COMPARISON:
- {涼|すず}しい: pleasantly cool (positive)
- {寒|さむ}い: cold (often uncomfortable)
- {暑|あつ}い: hot (often uncomfortable)
- {暖|あたた}かい: warm (pleasant)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {涼|すず}しい{風|かぜ}: cool breeze
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}をする: to act nonchalant (idiom)
- {涼|すず}しくなる: to become cool

NUANCE:
{涼|すず}しい has a positive connotation of refreshing comfort, unlike {寒|さむ}い which implies uncomfortable cold.
